requirements.title: Summary rule 1 — federation model
requirements.statement: Federations shall have an HLA FOM, documented in accordance with the HLA OMT.
requirements.machine_statement: Federations shall have an HLA FOM, documented in accordance with the HLA OMT.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-1; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary Rule 2
requirements.statement: In a federation, all simulation-associated object instance representation shall be in the federates, not in the RTI.
requirements.machine_statement: In a federation, all simulation-associated object instance representation shall be in the federates, not in the RTI.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-2; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary Rule 3
requirements.statement: During a federation execution, all exchange of FOM data among joined federates shall occur via the RTI.
requirements.machine_statement: During a federation execution, all exchange of FOM data among joined federates shall occur via the RTI.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-3; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary Rule 4
requirements.statement: During a federation execution, joined federates shall interact with the RTI in accordance with the HLA interface specification.
requirements.machine_statement: During a federation execution, joined federates shall interact with the RTI in accordance with the HLA interface specification.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-4; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary Rule 5
requirements.statement: During a federation execution, an instance attribute shall be owned by at most one joined federate at any given time.
requirements.machine_statement: During a federation execution, an instance attribute shall be owned by at most one joined federate at any given time.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-5; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary rule 6 — federate model
requirements.statement: Federates shall have an HLA SOM, documented in accordance with the HLA OMT.
requirements.machine_statement: Federates shall have an HLA SOM, documented in accordance with the HLA OMT.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-6; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary Rule 7
requirements.statement: Federates shall be able to update and/or reflect any instance attributes and send and/or receive interactions, as specified in their SOMs.
requirements.machine_statement: Federates shall be able to update and/or reflect any instance attributes and send and/or receive interactions, as specified in their SOMs.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-7; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary Rule 8
requirements.statement: Federates shall be able to transfer and/or accept ownership of instance attributes dynamically during a federation execution, as specified in their SOMs.
requirements.machine_statement: Federates shall be able to transfer and/or accept ownership of instance attributes dynamically during a federation execution, as specified in their SOMs.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-8; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary Rule 9
requirements.statement: Federates shall be able to vary the conditions (e.g., thresholds) under which they provide updates of instance attributes, as specified in their SOMs.
requirements.machine_statement: Federates shall be able to vary the conditions (e.g., thresholds) under which they provide updates of instance attributes, as specified in their SOMs.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-9; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.

requirements.title: Summary Rule 10
requirements.statement: Federates shall be able to manage local time in a way that allows them to coordinate data exchange with other members of a federation.
requirements.machine_statement: Federates shall be able to manage local time in a way that allows them to coordinate data exchange with other members of a federation.
requirements.coverage_note: Framework rule semantic group framework-rule-10; this normative surface is document-wide and is not owned by a state-machine transition.
